{{Expand Portuguese|topic=bio|Elza Berquó}}
{{Short description|Brazilian mathematician and statistician}}
'''Elza Berquó''' (17 October 1925 – 16 July 2026) was a Brazilian mathematician and professor known as a pioneer in [[demography]] in [[Brazil]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elza Berquó, 92: uma das mais importantes demógrafas do país |url=https://vejasp.abril.com.br/cidades/demografa-elza-berquo/ |access-date=2026-08-21 |website=VEJA SÃO PAULO |language=pt-BR}}</ref> She was among the earliest researchers to identify Brazil's fertility decline, examined in the 1965 study ''Reprodução humana no distrito de São Paulo''.

A graduate of the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Campinas]] who completed her doctoral studies in [[biostatistics]] at [[Columbia University]], she founded the Center for Studies in Population Dynamics (Cedip) at the [[University of São Paulo]], which conducted research on human fertility and family planning.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Queiroz |first=Christina |title=Modelo eficaz |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/modelo-eficaz/ |access-date=2026-08-21 |website=Revista FAPESP |language=pt-br}}</ref> In the 1980s, she directed the Núcleo de Estudos de População at the [[State University of Campinas]], studying gender and racial topics, particularly health problems faced by the [[Afro-Brazilians|Afro-Brazilian population]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Queiroz |first=Christina |title=Aos 100 anos, a demógrafa Elza Berquó ganha site na Unicamp com sua produção científica |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/aos-100-anos-a-demografa-elza-berquo-ganha-site-na-unicamp-com-sua-producao-cientifica/ |access-date=2026-08-21 |language=pt-br}}</ref> 

A member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]], she was awarded the Grand-Cross of the [[National Order of Scientific Merit]] in 1998.<ref>{{citation|url=https://jornal.unicamp.br/en/video/2026/07/17/adeus-a-elza-berquo-pioneira-da-demografia-brasileira/|title=Farewell to Elza Berquó, a pioneer of Brazilian demography|date=17 July 2026|work=Jornal de Unicamp|access-date=2026-07-20}}</ref> Berquó died on 16 July 2026, at the age of 100.<ref>[https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/economia/noticia/2026-07/morre-demografa-elza-berquo-referencia-em-estudos-populacionais Morre a demógrafa Elza Berquó, referência em estudos populacionais] {{in lang|pt}}</ref>
